title: Rioting for a reason
content: If you've glanced at the news lately, you've probably seen many reports about riots, looting, and violence at protests across Europe. These protests are driven mostly by young people demanding better school conditions and affordable housing, among other things. Yet many headlines focus on violence or riots rather than protestors' demands. Of the more than 10,000 news reports of protests in France by European outlets, just 8% of headlines explicitly mentioned protest demands. Meanwhile, around one in three headlines mentioned terms related to violence. In fact, some of the most-used words in headlines are associated with violence, including “riot”, “clash”, “chaos”, and “violence” itself.

title: Yhdysvallat uuden edessä – tutkija povaa presidentinvaaleihin ”nuoria valovoimaisia ehdokkaita”
content:
Presidentti Donald Trumpin nimeen vannoneella Yhdysvaltain republikaanipuolueella on edessä kova jälkipyykki välivaalitappion jälkeen. Mutta myös vaalivoitosta riemuitsevat demokraatit ovat uuden edessä, sanoo Pohjois-Amerikan tutkimuksen professori Benita Heiskanen Turun yliopistosta.

Tutkijan mukaan puolueessa on nousemassa esiin uusi sukupolvi, jolla on perinteisestä demokraattien politiikasta selvästi poikkeavia näkemyksiä. Demokraatit joutuvatkin nyt keskustelemaan siitä, miten kaikki saadaan mahtumaan samaan puolueeseen.

Heiskasen mukaan demokraatit joutuvat tunnustamaan sen tosiasian, ettei jonkun tietyn henkilön suhmuroiminen sisäisesti puolueen presidenttiehdokkaaksi ole enää voittava strategia. Ehdokasvalinta olisi parempi antaa äänestäjien päätettäväksi esivaalissa, Heiskanen sanoo.

- Presidentinvaaleissa (2028) tullaan näkemään nuoria valovoimaisia ehdokkaita, hän ennustaa.

Heiskasen mukaan senaatin ja edustajainhuoneen enemmistöt valloittaneet demokraatit eivät ole mikään yhtenäinen joukko, vaan esimerkiksi Israelin- ja Gazan-kysymyksestä tai terveydenhuollosta löytyy hyvinkin erilaisia näkemyksiä.

title: Why the weirdest game of 2026 is also one of my favourites
content:
Titanium Court is a bizarre world of 8-bit fairies, Shakespeare and surprise songs – its magic lies in never knowing what on earth is going on

• Don’t get Pushing Buttons delivered to your inbox? Sign up here

Earlier this year, I was stuck in hospital for several days, fuzzy on pain medication and bored out of my mind, with nothing but a Steam Deck for company. In the middle of one of those long nights, unable to sleep, I played a game called Titanium Court. It’s a strange creation that looks like it was made for the ZX Spectrum and reads like a postmodern Shakespeare adaptation – a compelling mix of strategy game and match-3 where you rearrange battlefields by matching tiles, before sending tiny lo-fi fairy armies to their deaths.

title: Kuudelle tutkimushankkeelle kaupallistamisrahoitus Business Finlandilta
content:
The University of Helsinki currently has 22 Business Finland‑funded research projects underway that are preparing the commercialisation of new innovations, with total Business Finland funding exceeding €13 million.

The Research to Business projects aim to ready research‑based inventions for the market, for example by licensing a newly patented technology or by establishing a related spinout company after the project phase.

The six R2B projects launched over the summer and early autumn are based on three campuses as follows:

Meilahti

  • ReBiont’s bacterial therapeutic aims to restore a healthy gut microbiota after recurring Clostridioides difficile infections causing severe, even life-threatening symptoms. The project is led by university researcher Reetta Satokari.
  • In the SansCoeliac collaboration project a novel immune response-modifying treatment is being developed for celiac disease. The project is led by university researcher Tobias Freitag from the Faculty of Medicine, together with Professor Robert Luxenhofer from the Faculty of Science.
  • Clearome Bio project develops cleaner single cell sequencing. The project is led by postdoctoral researcher Ceren Seref‑Vujaklija.

title: 25 Citizens Arrested in Bam Over Social Media Posts
content:
According to HRANA News Agency, citing ISNA, 25 citizens have been arrested in Bam County.

On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor of Bam County announced the arrests, claiming that the individuals had been detained on charges of “disturbing public opinion” by publishing what he described as “false information, fabricated news, and rumors” on social media.

Hamid Hassaninia further stated that the individuals had been identified and arrested following continuous monitoring and surveillance of online activities by officers of the Cyber Police (FATA) in Bam County.

According to the judicial official, legal cases have been opened against all 25 arrested citizens.

The report provides no information regarding the identities of those arrested, their places of detention, or the specific content of the posts that led to their arrests.

title: Thailand: Two Uyghurs at Risk of Return to China
content:
(Bangkok) – Thai authorities should not forcibly return two Uyghur men to China, where they face grave risks of torture and other serious abuses, Human Rights Watch said today. The two men, whose names are not public for security reasons, were transferred from prison to immigration detention in Bangkok after receiving a royal pardon, apparently in preparation for deportation.

“Previous Thai governments have kept Uyghurs in inhumane detention for years and then complied with Beijing’s demands to send them to China, where they were forcibly disappeared,” said Elaine Pearson, Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul should end forced returns to China and allow the two Uyghur men to travel to a safe third country.”

title: Who gets to call the water “safe” – Spilling the Truth Workshop (7 October 2026)
content:
by Jakleen Al-Dalal’a

For someone checking a storm overflow map before a swim, the question may seem straightforward: is it safe to enter the water? title: AI ‘godfather’ Geoffrey Hinton: it might turn out we were better off without AI
content:
Nobel winner warns the tech could be near to triggering major incident such as power or banking shutdown

One of the “godfathers of AI”, Geoffrey Hinton, has said it could turn out that humans would have been better off never developing the technology as he warned it could trigger a large-scale incident this year or next, such as a temporary blackout of financial or power systems.

The Nobel prize-winning computer scientist told the Guardian he is not a “doomer” about the technology that is underpinned by his groundbreaking research into artificial neural networks and believes AI has the potential to lead to a “wonderful future” but he said “it might be that we would have been better off never developing it”.

title: Survey on Repository Metadata Collection and Curation Practices
content:
Metadata help people discover and reuse research outputs, and repositories play an important role in making this possible. But approaches to collecting, curating and sharing metadata can vary.

Through this joint survey, the Barcelona Declaration and COAR (The Confederation of Open Access Repositories) invite people who work with repositories to share their experience. The responses will help build a clearer picture of current practices, the challenges repositories face and where there may be opportunities to strengthen metadata practices across the community.

To support participation from repository communities around the world, the survey is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese. Offering these language versions helps lower language barriers and makes it easier for people to share perspectives from their own contexts.

The survey covers the following topics:

  • Repository scope and key practices
  • Metadata collection and curation practices
  • Metadata sources and how they are used to populate records
  • Metadata availability and reuse
  • Metadata use, challenges and opportunities

title: Tutkimus: Icehearts vähentää nuorisorikollisuutta myös lähiympäristössä
content:
Tuoreen rekisteritutkimuksen mukaan rikoksesta epäiltyinä poliisirekisteriin päätyneiden alle 16-vuotiaiden osuus väheni Icehearts-toiminnan kohdealueilla kaksi prosenttiyksikköä eli 18 prosenttia lähtötasosta. Tutkimuksessa havaittiin myös viitteitä kouluarvosanojen paranemisesta, ja myönteiset vaikutukset ulottuivat toimintaan suoraan osallistumattomiin lapsiin ja nuoriin. Tulokset vahvistavat aiempaa näyttöä Icehearts-toiminnan vaikuttavuudesta. Aiemmassa kustannusvaikuttavuustutkimuksessa yhden kasvattajan ja noin 20 lapsen joukkueen 12-vuotisen toiminnan laskennalliseksi yhteiskunnalliseksi nettosäästöksi arvioitiin vähintään 2,8 miljoonaa euroa.

Aalto-yliopiston taloustieteen väitöskirjatutkija Ellen Sahlströmin tutkimuksessa tarkastellaan Iceheartsin tarjoaman pitkäjänteisen tuen vaikutuksia toiminnassa mukana oleviin poikiin sekä tuen heijastevaikutuksia alueen muihin samanikäisiin lapsiin ja nuoriin. Icehearts-toiminnassa on myös tyttöjen joukkueita, mutta toimintaan osallistuneita koskeva tutkimusasetelma rajautui tässä tutkimuksessa poikiin.

title: Helsingistä Bolognaan: Una Europan kansainvälinen tohtoriohjelma avasi uusia tapoja tarkastella Suomen historiaa
content:
Doctoral researcher Iisa Aaltonen explores the public memory culture of Finland’s Independence Day and is completing her dissertation at two universities within Una Europa’s Cultural Heritage doctoral programme. The programme has taken her on an exchange to Bologna and offered new perspectives on cultural heritage, academic practices and the analysis of Finnish history.

Iisa Aaltonen is a historian, with a Master of Arts degree from the University of Helsinki, and she has also completed a master’s degree in cultural policy at the University of Jyväskylä.

Aaltonen found her way to Una Europa’s international doctoral programme through a recommendation from her supervisor. What particularly interested her in the programme were its diverse perspectives on cultural heritage, the opportunity for international experiences and networks, and a broader view of the academic world.

title: Creative Europe opens 2027 call for literary translation and promotion
content:
The call ‘circulation of European literary works’ supports the translation, publication, distribution and promotion of European literature, including novels, poetry, comics and plays, with a focus on works written in less widely translated languages.

Promoting reading and helping readers discover the diversity of languages and cultures reflected in European literature are also key objectives.

Publishers, booksellers and libraries are encouraged to work together to strengthen the book sector’s competitiveness. Ensuring fair pay and good working conditions for literary translators is also a priority.

Organisations in the publishing and book sector based in an eligible country can apply individually or as a group of two or more partners.

Each project must include a minimum of five eligible literary works, supported by a strong publishing strategy and a distribution plan.

The authors must be nationals or residents of an eligible country or be recognised as part of Europe’s literary heritage.

An online information session will take place on 17 November 2026 from 14:00 to 16:00.

Hankehakemukset edustivat elokuvan, kirjallisuuden ja valokuvauksen kaltaisia ilmaisumuotoja sekä äänitaidetta ja runoutta. Hankkeet lähestyivät yhteenkuuluvuuden tunnetta monesta näkökulmasta.

Tuetuissa hankkeissa yhteenkuuluvuutta tarkasteltiin laadullisesta eikä vain määrällisestä näkökulmasta, Samsonsen selittää.

title: Föreslå din favorit till Årets museum 2027
content:
Vilket museum inspirerar, överraskar och gör skillnad? Nu söker Sveriges Museer och Svenska ICOM kandidater till Årets museum 2027. Vem som helst kan vara med och påverka genom att föreslå ett museum som förtjänar att uppmärksammas för sitt arbete.

Varje år tilldelas ett svenskt museum utmärkelsen Årets museum för att ha visat prov på mod, kreativitet och spets. Priset lyfter fram museer som vågar tänka nytt, utvecklar sin verksamhet och stärker museernas roll i samhället.

Syftet är att uppmärksamma framstående museiarbete och inspirera till nytänkande verksamhet av högsta kvalitet. År 2027 delas utmärkelsen ut för 31 gången. Bakom priset står Sveriges Museer och Svenska ICOM.

Alla kan föreslå ett museum – stort som litet, från hela landet. De inkomna förslagen ligger sedan till grund för juryns arbete med att utse tre finalister.

Föreslå ditt favoritmuseum här>>

Årets museum ska uppvisa mod, kreativitet och spets inom ett eller flera av följande områden:

Relevans: Årets museum utgör en angelägen och inkluderande arena för människor och samhället.

Inspiration: Årets museum kan uppvisa framstående exempel på nyskapande och innovativ verksamhet inom något eller flera områden.

title: Suomi110-juhlavuoteen sopivia ohjelmia etsitään
content:
Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriö kokoaa tapahtumakalenteria juhlavuoden aikana toteutuvasta taiteesta ja kulttuurista. Ilmoittakaa tapahtumanne, näyttelynne ja muut sopivat ohjelmat osaksi Suomi110-juhlintaa!

Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriö järjestää 110 vuotta täyttävän itsenäisen Suomen kunniaksi yhteistyökumppaneidensa kanssa 28. helmikuuta 2027 juhlatilaisuuden. Tarkoituksena on lisäksi koota tapahtumakalenteri juhlavuoden aikana toteutuvasta taiteesta ja kulttuurista. Kalenteri julkaistaan vuoden 2027 alussa.

Kalenteria varten opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriölle voi toimittaa tiedot sellaisista tapahtumista, näyttelyistä tai muista ohjelmistoista, jotka edustavat suomalaista kulttuuria, kulttuuriperintöä tai taidetta. Näiden tulee olla alkuperäisiä suomalaisia teoksia, kuten näytelmiä tai sävellyksiä, suomalaisten taiteilijoiden näyttelyitä tai suomalaista kulttuuriperintöä käsitteleviä ohjelmistoja. Kokonaisuuksien tulee olla juhlavuoden (2027) puolella. Juhlavuoteen voivat osallistua niin valtakunnalliset tapahtumat kuin paikalliset yhteisötilaisuudet.

title: The San Francisco Public Library Launches a Free Online Archive with 80,000+ Historical Images & Documents to Explore & Download
content: Over 100,000 people move to the San Francisco Bay Area each year. Their motivations for doing so no doubt vary, but these days, the ambition to make a fortune at the epicenter of the tech industry — especially amid the rapidly inflating AI bubble — is hardly unheard of. Unfortunately, that desire can be so all-consuming as to crowd out any interest in, or even curiosity about, the city itself, to say nothing of its wider region. Yet the San Francisco we know today is the result of a story at least 250 years long, very little of which has much to do with venture capital or GPUs. Now, anyone who does want to make a start on understanding it can do so at the new-and-improved platform DigitalSF, with its more than 80,000 historical items available to view and download.

title: Canada’s “Associate” EU Membership Should Be Digital
content:
When European Union leaders traveled to Montreal this month for the EU-Canada summit, they launched a grandly named “Alliance for the Future,” proposing to make Canada an “associate member” of the EU. A key part of the plan should be digital.

Europe has already negotiated five Digital Partnerships with like-minded democratic countries. Japan was the first, inking a digital deal in 2022. Since then, the EU has established agreements with South Korea, Singapore, Brazil, and Canada. 

In Montreal, Canada and the EU agreed on a legal framework to protect data flows from localization barriers and decided that Canada could participate in the EU’s high-performance computing partnership. But the existing digital partnerships remain, fundamentally, non-binding talk shops.

The motivation behind strengthening the deals is clear: reduce reliance on the US and China. But reinforced digital partnerships with like-minded democracies must push back against strong protectionist instincts, while remaining open to new participants, including the US — perhaps through a revived transatlantic Trade and Technology Council.

title: Postal Service Surveilled Protest Activities Online With Little Rules, Oversight
content:
The U.S. Postal Service used social media surveillance to monitor and report on protests across the political spectrum, government records show.

The records, disclosed to EFF and other requesters suing the postal service under the Freedom of Information Act, show that the agency’s internet Covert Operations Program, or iCOP, routinely sifted through social media posts organizing and discussing protests with little records of any oversight or legal justification.

EFF filed suit in 2021 after Yahoo News disclosed the program’s existence and how the agency used it to monitor First Amendment protected activities. After years of delays and technical failures that led the agency to lose access to a trove of emails discussing the program, the postal service disclosed records to EFF and several other requesters this year.

title: Brussels sets slimline legislative agenda for 2027
content:
BRUSSELS — The European Commission is scaling back its legislative ambitions for 2027, prioritizing competitiveness, deregulation and economic security as the clock starts to run down on Ursula von der Leyen’s second term. 

According to its annual Work Programme and related annexes obtained by POLITICO, the EU wants to strengthen the single market, cut red tape, modernize industry and bolster its defense capabilities at a time of mounting geopolitical risks and economic uncertainty. 

The Commission released the final version of the program and annexes on Wednesday.

“The EU must retain the ability to forge its own path,” the Commission says, adding that “independence is our priority for Europe’s economy.” 

But with existing initiatives — such as the Industrial Accelerator Act — facing delays, Brussels is focusing on getting legislation that is already in preparation across the finish line. 

It’s also killing off proposals that have no chance of passing, along with a crop of outdated regulations — including one on sales of butter stocks to the long-defunct Soviet Union.

title: Peru: Closing the investigation into forced sterilisations perpetuates impunity
content:
Amnesty International condemns the decision by Peru’s Public Prosecutor’s Office to close the investigation into the forced sterilisation of 4,172 Peruvian women during the 1990s. This decision was taken pursuant to Law 32107, passed in 2024, which allows statutes of limitations to be applied to war crimes and crimes against humanity committed before 1 July 2002.

“Closing an investigation that the Public Prosecutor’s Office itself recognises as involving crimes against humanity is an affront to the victims, who have waited almost 30 years for justice. The Peruvian state cannot use a law that contravenes international law to block their path to truth, justice and reparation. This decision must be reversed and Law 32107 repealed to prevent it from continuing to be used as a tool of impunity,” said Ana Piquer, Americas Director at Amnesty International.

Closing an investigation that the Public Prosecutor’s Office itself recognises as involving crimes against humanity is an affront to the victims, who have waited almost 30 years for justice.”

title: Latino Voters Swing Away from Trump for "Terrorizing Our Communities": Marisa Franco of Mijente
content:
In 2024, Donald Trump won the presidency with the support of 44% of Hispanic voters, suggesting that a major realignment in party preferences might be underway. But just two years later, it appears much of that support has eroded. Sixty-one percent of Hispanic voters say they will now support Democrats in the midterms, including 11% who previously had voted for President Trump.

We get a bird’s-eye view of what to expect from the Latino vote from Marisa Franco, the co-founder and director of the advocacy organization Mijente. While ICE brutality will be at the front of voters’ minds, she says, Democrats cannot continue to take Latino voters for granted. “The vast majority of Latinos are working-class. Quite simply, they voted for Trump because they were looking at issues of economy, cost, inflation,” explains Franco. “And at the end of the day, these same issues have worsened under Trump’s administration, under Republican control. So people, I think, are looking for someone who’s going to explain what’s happening and propose solutions and be dogged about finding them.”

title: Nicaragua’s Future: Repression, Resistance, and Hope
content:
Register


Over the past two decades, Nicaragua has experienced one of the world's most dramatic declines in freedom, losing 49 points on Freedom in the World’s 100-point scale assessing political rights and civil liberties. The regime of Daniel Ortega and his wife and “co-president” Rosario Murillo has systematically dismantled democratic institutions, imprisoned political opponents, killed peaceful protestors, and shuttered thousands of civil society organizations, independent media outlets, and religious institutions. Moreover, it has exported its repression beyond Nicaragua's borders, targeting dissidents in neighboring Costa Rica with surveillance, intimidation, and violence. The regime has also deepened its cooperation with other authoritarian powers, including those ruling China, Cuba, Russia, and Iran.

title: Egypt’s crackdown on independent media reaches Mada Masr as editor faces trial
content:
Egypt convicted Mada Masr’s Lina Attalah in a hearing marred by violations, and ordered it closed

Originally published on Global Voices

Lina Attalah. Photo from Mada Masr website, used with permission.

A crackdown on independent media in Egypt is escalating.

The latest wave of suppression of the country’s last remaining critical voices began with the violent arrest of the entire newsroom of Matsada2sh, a fact-checking and open-source intelligence (OSINT) page that relies on social media and is run by young journalists. 

The six-person team was forcibly disappeared, illegally detained, and interrogated under torture for several days before being charged with terrorism and spreading false news. They remain in pretrial detention.

The crackdown then reached Mada Masr, one of Egypt’s most prominent independent outlets, and its founder and editor-in-chief, Lina Attalah. On November 11, Attalah is due to stand trial for the second time in two weeks, this time on charges of spreading false news that carry a possible prison sentence.

title: Report on the Execution of a Juvenile Offender in Dezful and Two Other Prisoners in Isfahan
content:
According to HRANA, citing Iran Human Rights Organization, two prisoners were executed on Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, in Isfahan Central Prison.

The prisoners have been identified as Mobarak Mohammadi, 43, and Ghasem Molla Amini, 49, both Afghan nationals from the city of Sheberghan.

According to the report, the two prisoners had been sentenced to death by the Revolutionary Court in a joint case involving drug-related charges. An informed source stated that they had been arrested approximately two years earlier on a road leading to Isfahan on charges of transporting drugs.

The source further stated that Mobarak Mohammadi was the father of four children, while Ghasem Molla Amini was the father of three. The two men were related and had been living with their families in the city of Mashhad.

Juvenile Offender Executed in Dezful

In a separate report, Iran Human Rights Organization stated that a juvenile offender was executed in Dezful Prison on August 19, 2026.

title: Japan: Raise Rights With Vietnam’s Leader
content:
(Tokyo) – Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi should urge Vietnamese President To Lam to make concrete progress on human rights during his official visit to Japan from November 8 to 11, 2026, Human Rights Watch said today.

Human Rights Watch wrote to Prime Minister Takaichi expressing concerns about Vietnam’s intensifying crackdown on human rights. The repression violates obligations that Vietnam accepted under the 2018 Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership, to which Vietnam and Japan are parties.

“The Vietnamese government has broken its pledges for reform and continues to crack down on basic freedoms,” said Kanae Doi, Japan director at Human Rights Watch. “Prime Minister Takaichi should communicate clearly and publicly to President To Lam Japan’s serious concerns about human rights and labor rights violations.”

The Vietnamese government has sharply intensified its repression of basic freedoms over the past decade, Human Rights Watch said. To Lam served as Vietnam’s minister of public security from 2016 to 2024, heading the country’s national police force. He is now both general secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam and president.

title: Op-ed | The Children We Cannot Afford to Overlook
content:
Conflict and humanitarian crises have devastating consequences for healthcare systems, often leaving children without access to essential medical treatment. Yet the need for surgical care does not disappear when international attention shifts elsewhere. In this piece, Yusra Mardini and Sarah Masiyiwa explore why children’s surgical care must be a priority in humanitarian responses and long-term recovery.

In December 2024, the fall of the Assad regime, after nearly 14 years of devastating civil war, brought hope to many Syrians. But the end of a regime does not mean the end of a country’s suffering. When Yusra returned to Syria in 2025, ten years after being forced to leave her home, she found a country both familiar and profoundly changed. Beyond the physical destruction lay the enormous challenge of rebuilding the services and institutions people depend on every day.

Among them is surgical care for children.

title: Ilmastopolitiikka 1,5 asteen riskirajan ylityksen jälkeen
content:
Niko Humalisto on luontopolitiikan dosentti Itä-Suomen yliopistosta ja Suomen Lähetysseuran ilmastoasiantuntija. Hän vaikuttaa ilmastoneuvotteluissa kansainvälisen kehitys- ja humanitaaristen järjestöjen Act Allianssin teknisenä asiantuntijana. Vapaa-ajalla hänet löytää Turun polkupyöräpajalta.

Tulevassa Turkin COP31-ilmastokokouksessa ei voi enää uskottavasti vaatia ripeitä toimia  lupaamalla, että 1,5 asteen kuumenemisen rajan ylitys voidaan välttää. Tämän tieteellisiin riskirajoihin perustuvan velvoittavan tavoitteen epäonnistuminen ei kuitenkaan käynnistä ennalta määrättyä erityismenettelyä. Osapuolet joutuvat kehittämään uusia keinoja ylläpitää ilmastotoimien kunnianhimoa ja reagoimaan tulevaisuuteen, jossa sopeutumistoimien ja ilmastotuhojen painoarvo kasvavat.   

YK:n ympäristöohjelma UNEP kertoi syyskuussa, että maapallon keskilämpötilan nousua yli 1,5 asteen ei enää käytännössä voida välttää. Raportin optimistimmassakin skenaariossa lämpeneminen käy noin 1,8 asteessa. Tällainen polku edellyttäisi voimakkaita ja pitkäjänteisiä päästövähennyksiä tilanteessa, jossa monenkeskinen yhteistyö sakkaa ja kansainvälinen ilmastorahoitus ei ole lähelläkään riittävää tasoa.

title: Why I'm still paying the price of being a mother
content: It’s 9.30. After feeding two sleepy humans aged three and six, getting them ready and walking them to school, I’ve finally sat down at my desk to do some work – paid work I should say – and write this piece I’ve been putting off since the beginning of September. I've been thinking about it ever since I read the report on the motherhood penalty that the Haut Conseil à l’Égalité (HCE), a French national advisory body, published right in the middle of the back-to-school rush, a particularly stressful time of year for a working mother. Until the afternoon school's clubs started less than a month ago, I had to leave my desk every day at 15.30 to pick up the children, while my partner was still at the office. The rest of the day, I'd take them to the park, run their baths, and make dinner. So, yes, motherhood has meant less time to work – and less income. Around a third less than before having children. title: Mercator Switzerland Foundation joins IJ4EU as co-funder
content:
Mercator Switzerland Foundation has joined the Investigative Journalism for Europe (IJ4EU) programme as a new co-funder, helping sustain public-interest reporting across the continent and beyond.

The Swiss foundation joins the Dutch Adessium Foundation, the Norwegian Fritt Ord Foundation, and the German Free State of Saxony in providing co-funding alongside core financing from the European Union’s Creative Europe programme.

Mercator backs pioneering projects, invests in civil society organisations, and builds broad alliances to advance its vision of a democratic, equitable, and ecologically sustainable society. Its work includes strengthening journalism and ensuring people have the information they need to participate in democratic life.

Its financial contribution to the 2026-27 edition of IJ4EU will help fund activities delivered by the programme’s implementing partners: the International Press Institute (IPI) in Vienna, the European Journalism Centre (EJC) in Maastricht, and the European Centre for Press and Media Freedom (ECPMF) in Leipzig.

title: Nepal Anti-graft Body Charges ex-PM Madhav Nepal, 96 Others with Corruption
content:
Nepal’s anti-corruption agency on Tuesday filed corruption charges against former Prime Minister Madhav Kumar Nepal and 96 others over an alleged land-swap scheme that investigators say cost the government roughly $4.8 million.

The case, brought by the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA), centers on the illegal sale of land that should have been returned to government ownership, according to a commission statement.

The CIAA also charged Minendra Prasad Rijal who served as minister for federal affairs and parliamentary affairs and coordinator of the cabinet’s social committee at the time of the alleged scheme.

“Summons will be issued for all of them starting tomorrow to appear in court,” Parwati Hitan, the Special Court’s information officer, told OCCRP. She said defendants will have 15 days to appear, and that this can be extended by seven days. None has been detained.

“Once they appear, their statements will be recorded, and after their statements, the hearing process moves forward,” Hitan said. Witness statements and evidence would follow before a bench issues a final decision, she added.

title: How We’re Covering the Midterms — and the Aftermath
content:
This has been a midterm election cycle unlike any other. Wealthy donors spent staggering sums. Both parties moved to redraw congressional district lines. President Donald Trump and his allies relentlessly questioned whether the results could be trusted even before a single ballot was counted. At Trump’s direction, the Justice Department filed a lawsuit that said the federal government would contest any outcome in which Sen. Dan Sullivan, the Republican incumbent in Alaska, was not victorious.

Newsrooms, including ours, have tried to plan how we will cover an election in which the losing side refuses to accept the will of the voters. Was the Alaska lawsuit a single data point or a harbinger?

As we prepare to write about Nov. 3 and beyond, we find ourselves in the uncomfortable position of trying to game out what might happen in the future — not our strong suit. The record shows that journalists are pretty good at telling readers what happened, particularly if we have some time and some data to sift through, and much less good at forecasting the future.

title: Joulun tilitys lähestyy – tee ääniteilmoitus ja tarkista omat tietosi
content:
Joulun tilitys maksetaan viikolla 50. Huolehdithan ääniteilmoitukset kaikista jo julkaistuista biiseistä meille viimeistään 16.11., jotta ne ehtivät mukaan joulun tilitykseen.

Tarkista myös omat tietosi, kuten tilinumerosi ja veroprosenttisi MyGramex-portaalista ennen tilitystä. Puutteelliset tiedot voivat estää korvausten maksun ja joudut odottamaan rahojen maksua seuraavaan tilitykseen asti.

Joulun tilityksessä maksetaan korvauksia mm. radiosoitosta (ajalta heinä-syyskuu 2026), taustamusiikista sekä ulkomailta. Sekä lisäksi korvauksia on demand-, netti-PVR- ja kopiointikäytöstä.

Korvaussummat tulevat näkyviin MyGramexiin lähempänä maksupäivää. Korvauserittelyt näkyvät MyGramexissa maksupäivän jälkeen.

  • Tee muutosverokortti ensin OmaVerossa.
  • Odota hetki, jotta Verohallinto päivittää uuden verokortin tietoihinsa.
  • Tämän jälkeen palaa MyGramexiin ja hae uusi verokorttisi klikkaamalla “Hae Verokortti Verohallinnosta” -painiketta. Muutos päivittyy näkyviin portaalissa hetken kuluttua.

title: Sanaston lausunto koskien tekoälyä ja tekijänoikeutta
content:
Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriön lausuntopyynnössä kysyttiin näkemyksiä vastuullisen tekoälyn kehittämistä ja käyttöä koskevan hankkeen asiantuntijapienryhmien (luova työ, teknologiaryhmä ja juridiikkaryhmä) ehdotuksista.

Sanasto kannattaa eri ryhmien ehdotuksia erityisesti siltä osin kuin ne vahvistavat luovan työn tekijöiden oikeuksia ja asemaa tekoälyn aikakaudella. Sanasto pitää tärkeänä sitä, että vahvaa tekijänoikeutta puolustetaan ja tuetaan lainsäädännöllä tekijöiden oikeutta asianmukaiseen korvaukseen. Tekijöiden oikeus asianmukaiseen korvaukseen on turvattava, kun heidän teoksiaan hyödynnetään tekoälyn kouluttamisessa tai muussa tekoälykäytössä.

title: Suomen Arkkitehtiliiton asiantuntijalausunto: RTS 26:26-28 Asunnon tilat, asuinhuoneet ja oleskelutilat sekä keittiöt ja ruokailutila
content:
Suomen Arkkitehtiliitto kittää mahdolisuudesta lausua asuntosuunnittelua käsittelevistä ohjekorttiehdotuksista asunnon tilat, asuinhuoneet ja oleskelutilat sekä keittiöt ja ruokailutilat. Ohjekorttiehdotuksissa esitetty mitoitus edustaa hyvää asuntosuunnittelua, ja on hyvä, että ne ohjaavat esimerkilliseen mitoitukseen. Tilavarausten huomioiminen esimerkiksi lämpöpattereiden vaatiman tilan osalta on sisällytetty kattavasti ohjekortteihin. Käytännön asuntotuotannossa tilojen mitoitusta on trendinomaisesti kiristetty aikaisempien korttien hyvistä ohjeista huolimatta, ja toivomme näilä ohjekorteilla olevan ohjausvaikutusta asuntosuunnitteluun tulevaisuudessa. Alla esitämme kehitysehdotuksia ohjekortteihin:

Ohjekorttien havainnollisuutta lisäisi porrashuoneen esittäminen esimerkiksi vinjettikuvana, jolloin asunnon suhde koko rakennukseen kävisi ilmi periaatetasolla. Mikäli “Asuntosuunnittelu. Asunnon tilat” -kortin tavoitteena on toimia muut kortit kokoavana ohjeena, ehdotamme että sen roolia suhteessa muihin asuntosuunnittelun ohjekorttisarjan kortteihin selvennetään ja täydennetään tältä osin.

title: Search launched for new CEO of CMI – Martti Ahtisaari Peace Foundation
content:
CMI – Martti Ahtisaari Peace Foundation today launches a search to find its next CEO. The application period is open until 17 November.

The new Chief Executive Officer will lead the organisation and help shape the future of peacemaking.

Founded by Nobel Peace Laureate Martti Ahtisaari, CMI is an independent peace mediation organisation that works to prevent and resolve political conflicts through dialogue and mediation.

CMI brings people together who might not otherwise meet, builds trust across political divides and supports those closest to a conflict in shaping their own paths towards peace.

The organisation hopes to find an internationally experienced senior leader who combines a strong understanding of diplomacy and peace processes with executive leadership experience.

The position is based in Helsinki, Finland. The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with MPS. Read the full role description here and apply by 17 November 2026.

title: Mobilisation without realignment
content:
Israel’s October 2026 elections produced a striking paradox. After three years of devastating wars, the failures surrounding 7 October, growing international isolation and deep domestic divisions, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s governing bloc has lost its parliamentary majority. Yet Likud remains the largest party, and Netanyahu’s electoral performance was considerably stronger than many had anticipated.

According to the final count published by the Central Elections Committee on 29 October, Netanyahu’s bloc won 53 seats, compared with 48 for the Jewish-led opposition and a historic 19 for Arab parties; official certification is due on 4 November. This leaves 67 seats outside Netanyahu’s bloc, opening several possibilities for political change. However, the result should not be interpreted as an ideological shift towards the left. Much of the opposition consists of security-oriented centrists, nationalists and right-leaning liberals who explicitly distance themselves from Social Democracy.

title: Levyarvio: Uuden musiikin kilpailun hurjan hanuristin soololevy toimii
content:
Kansanmusiikista syntyy valitettavan harvoin koko kansan ilmiöitä. 90-­luvulla Värttinän Miinan laulu kyllä sai aikaan mediakohun, ja 2000-luvulla Loituman Ievan polkka virisi viraalihitiksi. Nyt meillä on jälleen kappale, jonka kaikki tietävät: Antti Paalasen Takatukka.

Uuden musiikin kilpailun yllättäjä saa seurakseen muita vetäviä kappaleita Paalasen pitkäsoitolla Haitarimarinadi. Valloittavia, elämänmyönteisiä, kujeilevia ralleja, joista kuntosalille sopii Aerobikki ja illanistujaisiin Ihan vaan käymään.

Antti Paalanen on kansanmusiikin tohtori. Tilanteen niin vaatiessa pohjalaiset pelimannisävelmät soivat kurtussa kurinalaisesti juuri niin kuin perinne velvoittaa, mutta soolotuotannossaan tämä hurja hanuristi ja komia kurkkulaulaja on luonut jotain sellaista, mitä meillä ei muuten olisi. Lapsenakaan hän ei huomannut mitään ristiriitaa kansalaisopiston haitari­piirin ja Kissin tai AC/DC:n diggailun välillä.

Haitarimarinadin kappaleita ovat Antti Paalasen kanssa luoneet hänen vaimonsa Heidi Maria Paalanen sekä popmusiikin puolella menestyneet Saara Törmä ja Lauri Halavaara. Tämä tiimi toimii!

title: In Praise Of Japan’s Failure To Keep Up
content:
TOKYO — Nothing triggers the bog-walloping Fenian in me quite like a visit to the British Embassy. This one, with its fine Georgian-revival facade, looked on my last visit a decade ago like a lost Cotswold manor-house brought to life in Tokyo.

But what was it that I found so unsettling? Perhaps the stately setting? Or its gilt-framed displays of a preternaturally regal, late queen? Her gaze following me about the room as I moved among the fine art and mahogany, like those creepy Sacred Heart of Jesus portraits I grew up with. Me, a lad reared in an Irish republican home where the Queen’s annual Christmas messages were as welcome as a poltergeist.

To the more clubbable, the embassy’s English country house manner would have seemed merely civilized; a demonstration that Merrie England had acquired over generations the ability to arrange the upholstery without the aid of an AI shepherd.

title: ‘National priority’ policies claim to solve Europe’s housing crisis. They may make it worse
content:
Housing shortages and soaring rents are central to Spain’s upcoming general election. As each party presents voters with ways of addressing the crisis, far right party Vox is backing a simple solution: the principle of prioridad nacional, or “national priority”, which would put Spaniards first in line to receive government benefits.

The policy is central to Vox’s programme. It proposes expanding social housing with priority for Spanish nationals, alongside deregulation and tax reductions.

It is presented as a common sense solution, but national priority does not actually address the root causes of scarcity. In fact, it could even make them worse.

The housing crisis, like many crises, has winners as well as losers: while tenants struggle, landlords collect higher rents and enjoy rising asset values. National priority does not change or tackle these underlying inequalities. Instead, it merely ranks neighbours by entitlement to assistance, while also sowing the seeds of social division.

title: Elinkeinoelämän vaalitukikassa on yli miljoonan muhkeampi kuin ay-liikkeen – näin palkansaajaleiri tukee ehdokkaita
content:
Elinkeinoelämän ja palkansaajien ehdokkaille tarkoitetuissa vaalirahakassoissa on runsaan miljoonan euron kuilu.

Pro Markkinatalouden paljon puhuvat kysymykset tuen hakijoille paljastuivat eilen. Demokraatti selvitti, miten ammattiyhdistysliikkeen Pro reilumpi yhteiskunta -yhdistys aikoo jakaa vaalirahaa.

Työnantajajärjestöjen tukema Pro Markkinatalous -yhdistys jakaa tulevissa eduskuntavaaleissa noin kaksi miljoonaa euroa tukea ehdokkaille. Kysymykset, joita yhdistys vaalirahoitusta hakeville esittävät, ovat herättäneet ihmetystä. Helsingin Sanomat julkaisi kysymykset maanantaina.

Kysymyksenasettelusta pystyy lehden haastattelemien tuen hakijoiden mielestä päättelemään varsin helposti, mikä on yhdistykselle mieluisin tai ”oikea” vastaus.

Kritiikkiä kysymykset saivat siitä, etteivät ne anna tilaa annettujen vastausvaihtoehtojen väliin sopivalle ratkaisulle. Ainoa välimallin vastaus on ”En osaa sanoa”.

Esimerkiksi julkisen talouden velkakriisin ratkaisuksi tarjotaan pääasiassa menoleikkauksia tai pääasiassa verotuksen keinoja. Vastaavia kysymyksiä on esimerkiksi perintöveron sekä viikonloppu- ja iltalisien poistosta.

title: Baltic Sea Region mental health work presented at the WHO Regional Committee for Europe
content:
The approach of the Baltic Sea Region Mental Health Platform was presented to health ministers and delegates of the 53 Member States of the WHO European Region at the 76th session of the WHO Regional Committee for Europe (RC76), held in Copenhagen on 27-29 October 2026. Ülla-Karin Nurm, Director of the NDPHS Secretariat, which leads the platform and coordinates Policy Area Health in the EU Strategy for the Baltic Sea Region, took the floor under three agenda items.

A session with mental health on the agenda

The Regional Committee is WHO’s decision-making body in the European Region and sets the direction for regional health policy. This year, Member States adopted “Ageing is living”, the regional strategy on healthy ageing for 2026-2030. They were also consulted on a new strategy to tackle noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) and advance well-being through health promotion, due for adoption in 2027. WHO/Europe also raised the possibility of a complementary regional strategy on mental health and well-being for the same period, which is still under discussion. The consultation comes 40 years after the Ottawa Charter for Health Promotion.

title: Gazan tulitauko on olemassa vain paperilla, sanoo yli sata järjestöä
content:
Lokakuussa 2025 alkaneesta tulitauosta on kulunut vuosi, mutta Gazan tilanne on kohentunut vain vähän. Näin arvioi yli 100 järjestöä yhteisessä kannanotossa. Mukana ovat muun muassa Pelastakaa Lapset, Norjan pakolaisneuvosto ja Amnesty International.

Järjestöjen mukaan Israelin iskut ja sotilasoperaatiot ovat tappaneet tulitauon aikana yli 1 400 palestiinalaista, joista yli 300 on lapsia. Gazan terveysministeriön tuoreimman luvun mukaan kuolleita on ainakin 1 480 ja loukkaantuneita yli 5 200. Israel on perustellut iskujaan Hamasin muodostamalla uhalla.

”Tulitauko on merkityksetön, jos lapsia tapetaan edelleen eivätkä perheet vieläkään pysty rakentamaan elämäänsä uudelleen”, sanoo Pelastakaa Lasten pääsihteeri Inger Ashing tiedotteessa.

Norjan pakolaisneuvoston pääsihteeri Jan Egeland kutsuu tilannetta häpeälliseksi.

”On äärimmäisen häpeällistä, että kokonainen vuosi tulitauon voimaantulon jälkeen palestiinalaisten tilanne Gazassa on kohentunut niin vähän”, Egeland sanoo.

title: UK climate minister Katie White: COP31 must respond to ‘really scary’ science
content:
The upcoming COP31 climate talks in Antalya, Turkey need to respond to the latest science on global warming, which is “really scary”, says UK climate minister Katie White.

In an interview with Carbon Brief setting out the UK’s priorities for the summit, White also responds to suggestions that the government is walking back its climate policies.

White says the “shocking” impact of extreme heat and wildfires this summer makes it clear that climate change “isn’t something far off; it’s something we’re living through”.

She adds that the UK will be working to “hold up the science”, including the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) reports that should be the “basis of discussions”.

The COP31 presidency push on electrification is “going to be key”, says White, who points to other priorities for the UK that include tackling methane emissions and reducing deforestation.

White says the recent approval of the Jackdaw gas field in the North Sea is “fully in line” with carbon budgets and that the UK continues to support the “transition away from fossil fuels”.

title: Suomalaisten tiedelehtien toimitustyö
content: Tieteellisten lehtien toimitustyö on keskeinen, mutta verraten vähän tutkittu osa akateemista julkaisujärjestelmää erityisesti kansallisissa, avoimesti julkaisevissa tiedelehdissä. Tässä artikkelissa tarkastellaan suomalaisten tieteellisten lehtien toimitustyötä organisoinnin, laadunvarmistuksen sekä kehittämisen ja toiminnan jatkuvuuden näkökulmista. Tutkimus perustuu Webropol-kyselyaineistoon, joka kerättiin alkuvuonna 2026 ja johon vastasi 94 toimitusten edustajaa 87 suomalaisesta tiedelehdestä. Aineisto analysoitiin yhdistämällä kuvailevaa tilastollista tarkastelua ja laadullista sisällönanalyysiä. Tulokset osoittavat, että suomalaisten tiedelehtien toimitustyö nojaa vahvasti pienten toimituskuntien vapaaehtoistyöhön ja niukkoihin resursseihin. Toimitustyön organisointi rakentuu vakiintuneiden mutta joustavien roolien varaan, joissa vastuu kasautuu usein päätoimittajille ja toimitussihteereille. Laadunvarmistus toteutuu pääosin luotettavien vertaisarviointikäytäntöjen, kollegiaalisen tuen ja yksittäisten toimittajien asiantuntijuuden kautta, mutta eettisten kysymysten systemaattinen käsittely ja dokumentointi ovat paikoin puutteellisia. Kehittämistyötä ja toiminnan jatkuvuuden turvaamista vaikeuttavat erityisesti ajan ja rahoituksen puute, vaikka toimituksissa tunnistetaan tarve kouluttautumiselle, dokumentaation vahvistamiselle ja osaamisen siirtämiselle. Artikkeli tuo näkyväksi kotimaisen tiedejulkaisemisen rakenteellisen haavoittuvuuden ja korostaa tarvetta vahvistaa toimitustyön institutionaalista tunnustamista ja kestävää resursointia.

title: Pohjois-Karjala näyttää suuntaa – kulttuurihyvinvoinnista osa suomalaista hyvinvointipolitiikkaa
content:
Miten kulttuurin hyvinvointivaikutukset saadaan nykyistä vahvemmin osaksi suomalaista hyvinvoinnin ja terveyden edistämistä? Pohjois-Karjalassa on kehitetty maakunnallista yhteistyötä, jossa kulttuuripalvelut, sosiaali- ja terveydenhuolto sekä kulttuurialan toimijat tuodaan lähemmäksi toisiaan. 

Suomen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollossa etsitään ratkaisuja kasvaviin kustannuksiin, väestön ikääntymiseen ja palvelujen saatavuuteen. Samalla korostuu tarve vahvistaa hyvinvointia ennaltaehkäisevästi. Taiteen ja kulttuurin mahdollisuudet ovat tässä keskustelussa edelleen osittain hyödyntämättä.

Taiteella ja kulttuurilla on monenlaisia myönteisiä yhteyksiä terveyteen ja hyvinvointiin. Tutkimuksissa on havaittu vaikutuksia muun muassa mielenterveyteen, sosiaaliseen osallisuuteen sekä sairauksien ehkäisyyn ja hoidon tukemiseen. Kulttuuritoiminta voi siten täydentää sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluja ja tarjota uusia mahdollisuuksia hyvinvoinnin edistämiseen.

title: Suomen tukema rahasto auttaa tunnistamaan Ukrainan sodan vainajia
content:
Ukrainassa toimiva uusi DNA-laboratorio on auttanut tunnistamaan lähes 200 sodassa kadonnutta henkilöä kolmen ensimmäisen toimintakuukautensa aikana. Laboratorion perustamista on tuettu Partnership Fund for a Resilient Ukraine (PFRU) -rahastosta, jota Suomi rahoittaa yhteensä 8,8 miljoonalla eurolla vuosina 2022–2027 osana Suomen kahdenvälistä kehitysyhteistyötä Ukrainassa. Suomen lisäksi rahastoa rahoittavat Viro, Ruotsi, Norja, Sveitsi, Iso-Britannia ja Kanada.

Ukrainassa on tällä hetkellä yli 100 000 sotaan liittyvää kadonnutta henkilöä, ja yli 18 000 vainajaa odottaa tunnistamista. Kadonneet henkilöt ovat valtaosin rintamalla kadonneita sotilaita.  Rikosteknisten laboratorioiden määrä on yli kaksinkertaistunut hyökkäyssodan alkamisen jälkeen.

PFRU on tukenut DNA-laboratorion perustamista yhden Ukrainassa toimivan alueellisen rikosteknisen laboratorion yhteyteen. Uusi alueellinen DNA-laboratorio on mahdollistanut vainajilta otettujen näytteiden tutkimisen paikallisesti ja auttanut purkamaan tunnistustutkimusten ruuhkaa kasvavan tarpeen keskellä. Laboratorion kolmen ensimmäisen toimintakuukauden aikana on pystytty tunnistamaan lähes 200 kadonnutta henkilöä.

title: Trifectan jatko vai sininen aalto? Katsaus Yhdysvaltain välivaaleihin 2026
content:
Välivaaleissa ratkaistaan senaatin ja edustajainhuoneen enemmistö. Vaikka demokraatit voittaisivat, kovin suuria muutoksia Yhdysvaltain politiikkaan tuskin on tulossa.

Marraskuun alussa pidettävät Yhdysvaltojen välivaalit ovat herättäneet keskustelua laajalti myös Suomessa. Välivaaleihin lähdetään tilanteesta, jossa republikaanipuolueella on Donald Trumpin presidenttiyden lisäksi enemmistö sekä senaatissa että edustajainhuoneessa.

Tämä republikaanien niin sanottu Trifecta on koossa pienimmän mahdollisimman enemmistön turvin: 218 edustajaa sekä yksi itsenäinen edustaja, joka äänestää republikaanien mukana, kun taas demokraattipuolueen edustajia on 214. 

Välivaalien seurauksena ratkaistaan edustajainhuoneen 435 paikan enemmistö sekä senaatin enemmistö, kun senaattoreista kolmasosa on uudelleen ehdolla.

Presidentti Trumpin historiallisen alhainen kannatus, yhdysvaltalaisia äänestäjiä huolestuttava talouden tila sekä esimerkiksi Iranin sota povaavat menestystä vaaleissa demokraateille.  Republikaanit voivat silti pärjätä vaaleissa kohtuullisesti vaalijärjestelmän, johtuen vaalijärjestelmän erityispiirteistä sekä vaaleihin ja vaalijärjestelmään kohdistuneista toimenpiteistä.

title: Beyond Edit-a-Thons: Building Sustainable Pathways for Queer Wikimedia Contributors
content:
What happens after the event ends? Reflections from Queering Wiki 2026 on strengthening Wikimedia communities and sustaining participation.

Wikimedia communities know how to bring people into the room. Edit-a-thons, workshops, and campaigns introduce people to free knowledge, help them develop skills, and create opportunities to connect with others. But what happens when the event ends?

Some participants may want to continue contributing but need guidance, resources, or opportunities to collaborate. Others may be ready to take on new responsibilities but not know where to begin. Without pathways to continued participation, the momentum created by an event can be difficult to sustain.

This question shaped my presentation, “Beyond Edit-a-Thons: Building Sustainable Pathways for Queer Wikimedia Contributors,” at the Queering Wiki Conference 2026 in Montréal, Canada. Drawing on the work of the EduWiki Hub, I explored how mentorship, peer learning, shared resources, and community support can contribute to more sustainable participation.

An event can introduce someone to Wikimedia, but attendance alone does not tell us whether they feel connected, supported, or able to continue contributing.

title: What a Storm Overflow Alert Leaves Unsaid – Spilling The Truth Workshops (14 and 24 September 2026)
content:
by Jakleen Al-Dalal’a

When an overflow map reports that a discharge has stopped, what does that tell someone standing beside the water?

The map may no longer show an active release. It cannot necessarily tell them what was discharged, how much entered the river, where it has travelled, or whether other sources of pollution are present. Yet people may consult that same map before swimming, taking children paddling, or bringing a group of volunteers to the river.

title: Hackers behind $6.3bn Binance heist ‘used malware and bogus job interviews’
content:
Firm reveals details about how its cryptocurrency exchange was compromised, saying operation began in June

The hackers behind the $6.3bn (£4.7bn) Binance heist used bogus job interviews, malicious software and an internal AI tool, the company has revealed.

The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange was compromised in an operation that began with an inadvertent download of malware in June, led to a recruitment scam in September and then a raid last week of “hot wallets” where billions of dollars worth of crypto-assets were taken.

title: Hyvinvoinnin historiaa -teos tietokirjallisuuden Finlandia-ehdokkaaksi – "Teos on erityisen ajankohtainen nyt"
content:
Antti Kariston ja Jussi Simpuran teos Hyvinvoinnin historiaa: Ajankuvia Suomesta (Gaudeamus) on valittu vuoden 2026 tietokirjallisuuden Finlandia-ehdokkaaksi. Jo kolmanteen painokseen edennyt tutkijoiden teos esittelee tuokiokuvia hyvinvoinnista itsenäisessä Suomessa ja osoittaa, että laajasta käytöstään huolimatta hyvinvointi ei ole yksiselitteinen käsite. Se on myös muuttunut ajassa paljon.

Sosiaaliturva ja sähkövalo, oppivelvollisuus ja olympiahenki, kirjastot ja kahvinjuonti… Mistä kaikesta puhumme, kun puhumme hyvinvoinnista? Antti Kariston ja Jussi Simpuran Hyvinvoinnin historiaa on aikamatka suomalaiseen yhteiskuntaan ja elämään itsenäisyyden vuosikymmeninä.

Helmikuussa ilmestynyt teos kuvaa, miten hyvin Suomessa on milloinkin voitu ja mitä on pidetty hyvänä elämänä – sekä miten hyvinvointia on haviteltu ja mistä sitä on luultu löytyvän. Itsenäisyyden ensiaskeleista kuljetaan läpi sotavuosien, hyvinvointivaltion rakennuksen, kasinotalouden ja lamavuosien.

Yksi maamme omaleimaisimmista musiikkitapahtumista, Savonlinnan museon oma Riihisaari Blues on jo ovella ja käynnistyy huomenna keskiviikkona 4. marraskuuta. Tällä viikolla Savonlinnan Riihisaaressa, Olavinlinnan kansallismaisemassa ja muualla Savonlinnassa järjestettävä tapahtuma on jo vakiintunut tärkeäksi osaksi itäisen Suomen syyskauden tapahtumatarjontaa.

title: Soviet Animations of Winnie the Pooh, Created by the Innovative Animator Fyodor Khitruk
content:
In 1962, the animator Fyodor Khitruk made his directorial debut with Story of One Crime, a film that broke with a Soviet tendency to make imitations of Disney-style animations. The film, as The Guardian explained in its 2012 obituary for the animator, came as a shock. It was stylistically simple and dealt with themes that Disney films would never touch — like, why would a polite clerk murder two housewives with a frying pan?

Khitruk made other films that were packed with social commentary, often taking aim at abuses in the Soviet system. But, he also made straightforward animations for children, none more famous than his series of films based on AA Milne’s beloved Winnie the Pooh books.

Created between 1969 and 1972, Khitruk’s three films star a bear named “Vinni-Pukh” who looks nothing like the Winnie the Pooh that Westerners grew up with. (You can see the original illustrations of Pooh by E.H. Shepard here.) But viewers will certainly recognize the storyline and spirit of the original Pooh in the Soviet adaptations. For decades, these films have enchanted East European viewers, both young and old. And they still occasionally appear on Russian TV.

title: A Tungsten Truce – Allies Cannot Compete for Access
content:
Maine-headquartered Elmet Group bought 4.99% of Vietnam’s Masan High-Tech Materials for about $125m on October 1. Alongside the stake, Masan agreed to supply and process about 1,250 metric tons of tungsten trioxide equivalent annually for at least eight years.

Alarm bells rang in Brussels, where internal European Union documents warned competition from partner countries could disrupt Europe’s access to Vietnamese critical minerals, Reuters reported. Masan is a key tungsten supplier to the continent, particularly Germany, and the immediate question is who will be served first if supplies run short.

The annual volume committed to Elmet equates to about 1,000 metric tons of tungsten metal. That is roughly a third of Vietnam’s estimated 2025 mine output. It also represents about 4.4% of broader European tungsten end-use demand in 2025, which Fastmarkets estimates at 28,700 metric tons of tungsten trioxide equivalent.1

Tungsten, about two and a half times as dense as iron, is used in missile components and armor-piercing ammunition.

title: Privacy's Defenders Podcast: The Secret Room
content:
The government’s surveillance powers grew rapidly after Sept. 11, 2001, some in public view and some in secret. EFF suspected but couldn’t prove that the National Security Agency was spying on Americans' communications. The New York Times sat on a story about it for over a year, finally publishing it in December 2005. Then, in January 2006, a retired AT&T technician named Mark Klein walked into EFF's office with a manila folder of documents that blew the story wide open. 

Welcome to the third episode of “Privacy’s Defenders,” a podcast about the people – lawyers, journalists, hackers, and others – who’ve fought to secure your digital liberties since before most people even knew what the internet was.

title: So you’ve vibe coded a website and you’d like us to take a look
content:
AI tools that allow people without coding skills to spin up a website are now commonplace, and this has resulted in a rapid rise in people getting in touch with us here at mySociety. These days, a large number of the emails we’re receiving begin something like: “Hey, I’ve created this website…”

While it’s not always explicitly mentioned, it’s pretty clear the vast majority of these sites have been vibe coded — that is, written entirely by AI, most likely based only on descriptions of the intended output, and almost always without any human review or even understanding of the underlying code.

We love to hear from the civic tech community, and of course we have a keen interest in technology that makes democracy more accessible. As AI is lowering the bar to folk making a tool they’ve imagined into a reality, new projects are launching thick and fast. We’d be foolish to ignore that.

But that said, we are getting a lot of emails.

title: After the Election: Revitalizing Serbian Democracy, and Lessons from the Opposition Victory
content:
Sun shining through a Serbian flag. (Photo Credit: Ivan Radic on Flickr CC BY 2.0)

Last month Serbia’s Student List, a youth-backed opposition movement, won parliamentary elections, ending 14 years of rule by longtime Serbian leader Aleksandar Vučić and his Serbian Progressive Party (SNS). The broad coalition grew from an ongoing protest movement sparked by the collapse of a renovated canopy at Novi Sad’s train station in 2024, which killed more than a dozen people and was widely blamed on government corruption.

Political rights and civil liberties had eroded significantly under Vučić’s rule as the government placed legal and extralegal pressure on the political opposition, independent media, and civil society organizations. As a result, Serbia’s Freedom in the World status declined from Free to Partly Free in 2019. Its score has since continued to decline, now registering 53 points on Freedom in the World’s 100-point scale—the lowest score in the western Balkan region and the second-lowest score in all of Europe. Turnout in the election was reported at a massive 70 percent, reflecting Serbian citizens’ desire for reforms in their country.

title: Changes to Chile’s Human Rights Institute Risk Leaving Victims Behind
content:
Chilean President José Antonio Kast introduced in Congress on October 19 a proposal to change the country’s National Human Rights Institute.

Founded in 2009 as an autonomous state body, the institute has worked to promote and protect human rights in Chile, including by taking legal action on behalf of human rights abuse victims.

If passed, the legislation would weaken some of the tools the institute uses to protect human rights and diminish its independence.

The bill would remove the institute’s eleven-member board of directors, replacing them with a new five-member transitional board that would draft new bylaws for the institute. Unlike the current board, which has four members who were selected directly by civil society groups, the new transitional board would be proposed by the president, approved by the Senate, and would have no members selected directly by civil society. This sits uneasily with the standards set out in the Principles relating to the Status of National Human Rights Institutions (the Paris Principles), which recommend that members be independent from the government and selected through a process that ensures broad civil society representation.

title: I took a five-star ride to the front line
content: At the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, it was still relatively easy to get to Kramatorsk, a city in eastern Ukraine's Donetsk region. I remember my first trip in 2022, by train. I travelled from Kyiv to Kramatorsk on an old Soviet-era train, packed with soldiers and smelling of onions, cold cigarettes, and sweat. Since then, I have used almost every possible way of getting there. By car, by bus, Sprinter van, and car rental. But the closer Russian forces moved towards the city, the harder it became to reach. Trains to Kramatorsk stopped running in 2025. Then car-rental companies pulled out of the area, and we could no longer hire cars. “We have trackers on them,” one rental company employee once told me in Kyiv, giving me a threatening look. “Don’t try to fool me.” I took the bus that day. By the end of 2025, getting to Izium, 120 kilometres south of Kharkiv, was still relatively easy. The problem was getting from there to Kramatorsk, another 70 kilometres south. title: DRC Orders Probe into Illegal Mining Following Major Copper and Cobalt Seizure
content:
The Democratic Republic of the Congo will open an investigation into suspected mining fraud and widespread illegal mining, following the seizure of thousands of tons of copper and cobalt as well as more than 500 trucks and other machines, according to a statement by the Justice Ministry.

The probe comes two weeks after Congo's mines minister suspended the head of the state agency overseeing artisanal and ​small-scale mining, accusing him of failing to prevent illegal ‌mining on licensed concessions.

As the world’s largest producer of cobalt and second-largest producer of copper, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has long struggled with unauthorized miners and cross-border smuggling rings encroaching on industrial concessions held by foreign operators.

title: I Was There to Document the Aftermath of Deadly Flooding. Then, It Started Raining.
content:
Three summers ago, over Father’s Day weekend, my family and I went camping in the Lincoln National Forest, just a few hours drive north of our home in El Paso, Texas. It’s a beautiful area that’s long served as a getaway for the region, with skiing in the winter, and golf and hiking in the summer. My daughter played under the trees, and I rode my bike down mountain trails that, I noticed, seemed concerningly dry. 

The next evening, after we left to drive home, two fires started in forests surrounding the town of Ruidoso, New Mexico, around 25 miles away from where we’d been. I watched horrifying videos online of fire lapping the mountains behind the village’s strip malls and parking lots. The fires were eventually suppressed by a combination of human effort and the late summer monsoon season. But when the downpour of rain hit the burnt landscape around Ruidoso, it created another problem: Recurring floods then ripped through town, damaging homes and infrastructure, and leading to emergency rescues.

title: From Wales to Finland, minority language speakers still face prejudice
content:
“How very rude to be speaking Welsh.”

That was the complaint a stranger directed at Patsy, a Welsh learner featured in my latest book, after overhearing her family speaking Welsh in a Cardiff cafe. She could hardly believe it: “But you’re in Wales. What are you talking about?”

Wales has come a long way since the days of the Welsh not, a wooden token often accompanied by corporal punishment that was used in some 19th-century schools to discourage children from speaking Welsh. The Welsh language is now more visible, more widely supported and more politically protected than at any point in history.

But my ongoing research of Welsh-speaking families living in Cardiff suggests that while attitudes have improved dramatically, some linguistic prejudice still lingers beneath the surface. The pattern is not unique to Wales. I found similar experiences among Finland’s Swedish-speaking minority, where official recognition of the language has not always translated into acceptance in everyday life.

content:

Orpo ei ottanut suoraan kantaa siihen, voivatko venäläiset maastohiihtäjät osallistua marraskuun aikana Rukan maailmancupin osakilpailuun.

title: State of the climate: 2026 likely to tie with 2024 as the warmest year on record
content:
• A record August and the second-warmest year to date
  • A record-setting El Niño event
  • Record heat across much of the world
  • Good odds of being world’s warmest year 
  • Datasets are split on whether 2026 is headed for a record
  • 2027 very likely to be the warmest year on record
  • Earth’s energy imbalance has more than doubled
  • Arctic sea ice minimum tied for 10th lowest, Antarctic near record lows

    • With three-quarters of the year now past, it is virtually certain that 2026 will be the warmest or second-warmest year on record.

    A rapidly strengthening El Niño, alongside human-caused global warming, made this year’s August the warmest on record and September the second-warmest. 

    El Niño is the warm phase of a recurring climate pattern in the tropical Pacific that releases heat from the ocean into the atmosphere and temporarily boosts global temperatures.

    Carbon Brief’s analysis gives 2026 a 67% chance of surpassing 2024 as the warmest year on record across an average of six global temperature datasets. 

    In January, it is likely the groups that report global surface temperatures will be divided on whether 2026 officially beat 2024’s record.

title: Asevelvollisuusarmeija ja etenkin reserviupseerikoulutus ovat suomalaisen onnellisuuden kova ydin
content:
Puolustusbudjettiamme olisi syytä pohtia laajempien yhteiskunnallisten vaikutusten kautta. UKK-instituutin johtaja sanoo, että paras koskaan tehty keksintö kansanterveyden kohentamiseksi on yleinen asevelvollisuus. Jos vaikuttaa asevelvollisuus kansanterveyteen, niin takuuvarmasti se on myös tehokas kotouttaja. Aikuisuuden kynnyksellä vietetty aika asevelvollisena vaikuttaa yksilöön ja sitä kautta yhteiskuntaamme monin tavoin, joita eivät kriitikot ehkä ole tulleet ajatelleeksi.

Julkaisin RUK:n ”Jaarli” (nr. 183) -kurssimme 40-vuotisjuhlan kunniaksi kirjan, jossa pohdin asevelvollisuuden ja etenkin reserviupseerikoulutuksen merkitystä suomalaiselle yhteiskunnalle. Alun perin idea lähti vain siitä, että tiesin monien kurssitoverieni pärjänneen hyvin elämässä ja ajattelin heidän minibiografioidensa kiinnostavan muitakin kuin kurssikavereita. Olihan joukossa sentään niin Janne Jaakkola, Risto Siilasmaa kuin edesmennyt rocktähti Pete Wallikin. Monista muista kiinnostavista, jos ei niin tunnetuista nimistä puhumattakaan. Henkilökuvia tuli lopulta 19 ja siihen päälle omat RUK-muistelut.

title: The Virtual Room: How Volunteers Brought Wikimania Paris to the World
content:
From 22 to 25 July 2026, Wikimania Paris featured a room that nobody could physically walk into.

The Virtual Room was a dedicated digital space built exclusively for online attendees, complete with its own dedicated programming and unique content unavailable anywhere else at the venue.

As a member of the Core Organising Team (COT), co-lead of the Technical Committee, and the primary lead for the Virtual Room, I had a front-row seat to this experiment. This is the story of how a small, dedicated group of volunteers brought a digital-first stage to life.

One of our core commitments on the COT for Wikimania 2026 was to meaningfully engage the global remote audience, not just broadcast physical sessions at them. The Technical Committee pitched several ideas to bridge the hybrid gap, and the Virtual Room was our boldest initiative.

Unlike standard track rooms, the Virtual Room had no physical space where people sat and watched. It existed entirely online, streamed through the live section of Eventyay and broadcast on the Wikimedia Foundation’s YouTube channel.

title: Lappeenrannan Loistopuisto on ainutlaatuinen, pimeässä hohtava lasten UV-taideteoskokonaisuus
content:
Etelä-Karjalan lastenkulttuurikeskus Metkun Loistopuisto hohtaa valoa ympärilleen 23.11.2026 saakka Lappeenrannan Keskuspuistossa.

Loistopuisto on rakennettu ennen kaikkea Lapsen oikeuksien teemaviikon kunniaksi. Lapsen oikeuksien viikkoa vietetään 16.–22.11.2026. Tämän vuoden UV-teoksien teemana on Kuningatar Kristiinan hovi ja Saimaan eliöt. Loistopuisto on maksuton ja kaikille avoin – puisto teoksineen on osa Loistava Lappeenranta -kokonaisuutta.

– Väriä ja valoa välittävä lasten UV-taideteoskokonaisuus Loistopuisto on rakentunut Keskuspuistoon nyt jo seitsemättä kertaa. Tämän vuoden teemat juhlistavat järviluonnon monimuotoisuutta ja lapsen oikeuksia, avaa Metkun vastaava taideohjaaja, Tiinalotta Särmölä, joka on ohjannut lasten UV-taidetyöpajat.

Puiston teokset syntyivät Metkun taidetyöpajoissa Kesämäen ja Kimpisen koulun 2.-luokkalaisten ja Voisalmen koulun 4.-luokkalaisten tekeminä.

title: Mali: Still no accountability six months after abduction of pro-democracy politician Mountaga Tall and his son
content:
Malian authorities must urgently disclose the fate and whereabouts of lawyer and pro-democracy politician Mountaga Tall and his son Cheick Mamadou Tall, Amnesty International said six months after their abductions.

On the night of 3 May 2026, just days after a series of attacks by armed groups across Mali, Mountaga Tall, leader of the National Congress for the Democratic Initiative (Congrès national pour l’initiative démocratique), was abducted from his home in the capital, Bamako, by armed and hooded men driving vehicles without registration plates.

Cheick Mamadou Tall, his eldest son, went missing on 16 May after allegedly receiving a telephone call from his father asking him to bring personal effects. He left his home to deliver the effects and never returned. His fate has remained unknown since then.

title: January Protests: Amirhossein Maleki and Amirhossein Ebrahimi Executed
content:
According to HRANA, citing Mizan News Agency, the death sentences of Amirhossein Maleki and Amirhossein Ebrahimi, two defendants in the case known as the “Ali Khani Square case” in Isfahan, were carried out this morning.

The Judiciary’s Media Center has claimed that four law enforcement officers were killed during the protests on January 8, 2026, in Ali Khani Square in Isfahan. The institution also alleged that a number of protesters attacked law enforcement officers and damaged public buildings and property.

In outlining the charges against Amirhossein Ebrahimi, Mizan claimed that he was present in Ali Khani Square on the day of the incident and, while carrying a bladed weapon, participated in the destruction of public property and the assault of law enforcement officers. According to the report, Mr. Ebrahimi went into hiding at a relative’s home following the incident and was subsequently arrested along with his brother.

title: Ethiopian Authorities Suspend Independent Newspaper
content:
In what has become the new normal, the Ethiopian government has silenced yet another independent media outlet.

The Ethiopian Media Authority announced in a November 2 Facebook post that it is indefinitely suspending the print and online license of the Reporter, one of Ethiopia’s oldest media institutions. Publishing in English and Amharic, the Reporter is also the country’s last privately owned Amharic newspaper.

Stating that the suspension would take effect immediately, the Media Authority accused the Reporter of violating the country’s laws and media ethics by repeatedly publishing content that was against “national interests.” The authority added that the outlet published “distorted content that negatively affects foreign investment, tourism, and diplomacy.”

The action is part of the government’s ongoing assault on the media and civic space in the country and points toward increasing use of vague claims about “national interests” to shut down any critical reporting.

title: I’m a journalist in Türkiye, but I’m not in jail (yet)
content: In May, I bumped into my colleague Tuğba Tekerek at a gathering of Turkish journalists in Istanbul. “Freelancers should come together and look out for one another,” she said. “Sure,” I told her. “Let's brainstorm soon.” We never got the chance. Tuğba and I both worked at Deutsche Welle Turkish, although at different times. In 2024, she traveled to Georgia to report for a range of outlets, including LGBTI+ rights association Kaos GL. She's now in jail because of that reporting. When I started out as a journalist in 2010, losing a job didn't necessarily mean the end of a career. A colleague who was laid off could usually find another position. Today, stories like Tuğba's are becoming all too common. Türkiye is due to hold its next scheduled elections in 2028, unless an early vote is called. As we approach that date, media outlets critical of the governement are increasingly coming under pressure, and being taken over by state-appointed trustees, one by one. title: Vibe Coded AO3 Clone Site Down After Fanfic Authors Buried It With 2,000 Takedown Notices in a Single Day
content:
A vibe-coded site that scraped Archive of Our Own (AO3) fanfiction works, reuploaded them and charged for audiobook versions is down now after the creator said they received over 2,000 takedown requests from authors in the single day it was up.

ao3.life, a website that sprung up following last week’s announced weeks-long outage of fanfiction repository AO3, scraped the internet for works to populate the site using “a swarm of AI Agents controlling 40 virtual machines were scraping the internet for all drives, scrapes, and sources,” the site’s creator, named Ganesh, wrote on a page apologizing for the entire project. AO3.life went down on Monday evening following widespread backlash from readers and authors on social media. 

Before it went down, the ao3.life homepage said, “AO3, saved before it slips away. Search every fandom, ship and trope. Read it here, keep the EPUB, or let it read to you when your eyes get tired.”

title: Serbian Bank Tied to Outgoing Regime Collapses After Internal Vault Theft
content:
A Serbian commercial court officially launched bankruptcy proceedings against Belgrade-based Alta Banka on Tuesday and activated a state mechanism to refund depositors, just one day after top executives were arrested for allegedly stealing more than 45.5 billion Serbian dinars (more than $427 million) from the institution's vault.

The financial collapse stems from a massive alleged internal theft. In coordinated statements on Monday, the Public Prosecutor's Office for Organized Crime and the Interior Ministry confirmed the detention of the "responsible person" of Alta Banka, identified by authorities only by the initials D.M. (born 1981). The Serbian branch of regional N1 TV subsequently identified the suspect as Davor Macura. Also arrested were the director of the treasury and cash management department, G.M. (born 1987), and a treasury associate, I.P. (born 1982).

Macura is suspected of abusing his position to illegally extract the funds, defrauding Alta Banka of exactly 45,556,596,250 dinars—an amount worth more than $427 million—according to the Interior Ministry and the Public Prosecutor’s Office for Organized Crime.

title: Canada-EU alliance: as a blueprint for a ‘middle-power bloc’ it has a lot of hurdles to overcome
content:
The dream of a Canada-EU “middle-power bloc” has hit its first serious obstacle. At the Montreal summit, Brussels failed to deliver on the promise of associate membership for Canada, despite the enthusiastic backing of European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen.

Instead, the EU offered the hollow consolation of “an ever-closer association”, raising an uncomfortable question about whether the middle powers can overcome their own divisions to become a serious geopolitical force.

The two-day EU-Canada summit culminated on October 30 with the launch of a so-called “Alliance for the Future”. That compromise formula of association, rather than associate membership – which specifically ruled out full membership – was necessary because of internal disagreements in the EU.

In September, Von der Leyen, offered Canada the chance to become the EU’s first “associate member”. But Germany, backed by Greece and others, objected to the term, worried about legal uncertainty and the expectations it might raise in other countries.

content:
Yhdysvaltain presidentin Donald Trumpin mukaan Yhdysvallat lakkauttaa Israelille vuosittain jaettavan neljän miljardin dollarin suuruisen tuen.

Uutistoimisto Reutersin mukaan ei ollut täysin selvää, mihin tukeen Trump viittasi, mutta Yhdysvallat on jakanut Israelille 3,8 miljardia dollaria sotilasapua vuosittain.

Yhdysvaltojen Israelille myöntämästä vuotuisesta avusta on sovittu yhteisymmärryspöytäkirjassa, jonka voimassaolo päättyy vuonna 2028.

Trump kommentoi asiaa Fox News -kanavan haastattelussa. Trumpin mukaan asiasta on sovittu Israelin pääministerin Benjamin Netanjahun kanssa. Haastattelussa Trump sanoi tuen sisältävän sotilaallista apua sekä käteistä.

- He eivät tarvitse sitä. Israel on erittäin kukoistava maa, Trump totesi.

Trump kuitenkin myös sanoi, että Israel on Yhdysvaltojen kumppani numero yksi, ja jos maa tarvitsee tukea, voidaan sitä jatkaa.

Trump myös kommentoi tuen lakkauttamista Yhdysvalloissa tiistaina käytävien välivaalien valossa. Hän viittasi esimerkiksi Michiganissa ehdolla olevaan demokraattien Abdul El-Sayediin, joka on kritisoinut Yhdysvaltojen Israelille antamaa tukea.

title: How we measure contributions and recognise the most active contributors to Ukrainian Wikimedia sister projects
content:
Every year, Wikimedia Ukraine recognises some of the most active contributors to Ukrainian-language Wikimedia sister projects. To do this fairly, we look beyond simple edit counts: different projects involve very different types of work, so the indicators and tools we use depend on the nature of each project. This year, while determining winners for 2025, we also experimented with a new challenge — measuring contributions specifically to the Ukrainian-language layer of Wikidata.

For Ukraine, developing these projects has an additional significance. In the context of Russia’s full-scale war against Ukraine, preserving, expanding and making Ukrainian-language knowledge accessible online is also part of strengthening the visibility and resilience of Ukrainian culture, history and language in the global information space.

We are happy to present the 2025 recipients:

🥇 Albedo
🥈 Bicolino34

title: Väitös: Podcast-yhteisöjen voima rakentuu osallistumisesta, vuorovaikutuksesta ja oppimisesta
content:

Wendlandin mukaan monet menestyneet podcastit ovat rakentaneet asemansa nimenomaan vahvan yleisösuhteen avulla. Silti aidosti yleisölähtöinen sisällöntuotanto on yhä harvinaista.
